excerpt: European and Asian stocks fell due to geopolitical tensions, with the Dow Jones down over 300 points. US markets were closed for Juneteenth, and Trump had approved Iran attack plans but held off. Oil prices fluctuated, gold futures eased, and the U.S. dollar strengthened.

content.introduction: European and Asian stocks fell due to geopolitical tensions, with the Dow Jones down over 300 points. US markets were closed for Juneteenth, and Trump had approved Iran attack plans but held off. Oil prices fluctuated, gold futures eased, and the U.S. dollar strengthened.
body: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled more than 300 points as geopolitical tensions and worries about the state of the global expansion renewed concerns.
